summary: A path-traced, cut-out Lumi walking over the real front page is a fresh idea and it works in the author's Firefox run. My own sandbox screenshots show frame time fine (median 2.8 ms, p95 5.5 ms), but the golden-hour lamps and the hill's face are not visible from the follow camera.
surprise_why: The agent walks out of the game onto its own web page as a cut-out video, which changes where the game appears, not another island event.
